mechanism: Phenelzine is an MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate serotonergic effects; rilpivirine may have weak serotonergic properties and both drugs have CNS effects that could be additive, plus potential for hypertensive crisis if any sympathomimetic exposure occurs.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination is necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and counsel patients to avoid tyramine-rich foods and sympathomimetic agents.
